hard_criteria.description: Mandatory gates applied BEFORE any tool_fit scoring. A company must pass every gate to be scored; failures are excluded regardless of product fit.

gates.label: Headquarters in Taiwan
gates.rule: Global corporate HQ legally domiciled in Taiwan (not merely a Taiwan-born founder or a regional office).

gates.label: Well-established
gates.rule: Publicly listed (TWSE/TPEx) or clear market leader, founded >= ~15 years ago, with sustained multi-year revenue at scale. Excludes startups and early-stage vendors.

excluded_examples.note: HQ San Jose, USA (Taiwanese founder, but not Taiwan-domiciled).
Early-stage; also HQ not established as Taiwan.

methodology.scoring: After hard-criteria gating, each surviving company is scored 0-100 for fit against EACH Black Duck product independently. The recommended LEAD product is the weighted-max across products; default lead is Black Duck SCA/SBOM unless a stronger Defensics (protocol/safety) or Coverity (large embedded codebase) signal dominates.
methodology.note: No company list was supplied with the task. The set below is a representative sample of well-established, Taiwan-HQ companies drawn to satisfy the hard criteria and exercise the per-product scoring/lead logic. Replace with a real list to regenerate.
